answer: An effective defense ties each agent identity to a staked deposit locked over a long horizon and a verifiable record of completed work. A new identity starts at zero reputation and earns trust only through attested tasks, so spawning thousands of fakes costs thousands of stakes. Random audits add a regular pulse check: sampled agents must prove the work they claim. A failed audit slashes the stake and burns the identity. Even a sudden plume of newcomers cannot outvote established agents, because influence is priced in escrowed capital and proven history, not headcount.
